text: 准备Hi boys and girls.I'm Ms.Nice to meet you.Are you ready for the class?Now class begins.上个单元,我们认识了身边的小动物,了解了动物对人类的帮助,并且学会照顾小动物。There are many animals in our lives.What animals do you know?你知道哪些小动物呢?Good!Animals give us a lot of things.What do they give us?小动物能给人类带来什么呢?For example, what do bees give us?Right!Bees give us honey.How about other animals?Now please choose one picture.Say it by yourself.Well done!What do hands give us?What do horses give us?What do cows give us?How about the dogs?So animals are helpful.They can help us do a lot of things.你们上个单元,了解了很多关于动物的知识。Today we will learn unit 8, have a go.Have a go的意思是试一试吧。我们会学习小鸟是如何飞翔的,以及一首好听的歌谣。Listen!What's that sound?Can you guess?你能说说是什么声音吗?It is a bird.Follow me.Bird.What color is it?Yes, it's black.Black.People call it black bird.Please follow me.Black bird.Boys, can you try?Girls, you try.Great!It has a black body and a yellow beak.它有黑色的身体和黄色的嘴巴。It can sing nicely.它还很会唱歌呢。Is it nice?同学们,想知道我们身边的巫东是什么样的吗?一起来看看吧!Do you like black birds?Are they cute?厨老师,还有一首关于小巫东的歌谣。Let's enjoy!Children, how many little black birds do you see?你看到了几只小巫东?Yes, two.Where are they?他们在哪里呢?Two little black birds sitting on a hill.This is a hill, 小山丘.Please listen and follow.Hill.Look, they are sitting on a hill.Sitting.Sitting on a hill.坐在小山丘上。Please read after me.Two little black birds.Look, this is Jack.Let's say, Hello Jack!This is Jill.Let's say, Hi Jill!Listen, children.One named Jack, one named Jill.一只巫东叫Jack, 一只巫东叫Jill.Named.Good job.Now let's listen and follow.Boys, can you read?Let's read together.现在请大家一起来读一读这首歌的前四句哦。Now let's sing the song.Nice singing.Look, mother black bird is talking.Mother bird 在说些什么呢?Fly away, Jack.Fly away, Jill.Come back, Jack.Come back, Jill.原来,鸟妈妈要教宝宝们飞翔呀。他们是如何练习飞翔的呢?看,鸟妈妈正在做示范呢。She flaps wings.她正煽动着翅膀呢。Flap.Wings.Flap wings.Now, two little black birds can fly well.Let's have a look.Wow,两只小乌龟克服了困难,学会了飞翔。See, they look so happy.瞧,他们笑得多开心呀。Look, this black bird flies away.Fly away.飞过去, and this black bird comes back.Come back.飞回来Children, in which picture the birds fly away?哪幅图片表示小鸟 fly away?In which picture the birds come back?哪幅图片表示小鸟 come back?Yes, in picture A, the birds come back.In picture B, the birds fly away.Mother bird 是怎么叫Jack和只有飞翔的呢?Please follow.现在Jack和Jill知道怎样飞翔了。Boys, can you read together?Now, let's try together.接下来我们要完成听力练习了。Please open your books and turn to page 49.Take out your pencil and eraser.I have three pictures.Look, 小鸟飞哪儿去了呢?This picture shows the birds flying away.This picture 小鸟停在肩膀上。Oh, look, 小鸟飞回来啦。Now, please look, listen and write the number in the box.请小朋友们听录音。用数字一、二、三给图片排序。OneLook, the bird is sitting on my shoulder.TwoThe bird is flying away.ThreeThe bird is coming back.Have you finished?Look, the bird is sitting on my shoulder.The bird is flying away.The bird is coming back.你们都做对了吗?Now, let's sing the song together.Two Little Black BirdsTwo little black birds sitting on the hill.Fly away Jack, fly away Jill.Come back Jack, come back Jill.Two little black birds sitting on the hill.大家都学会了吗?让我来考一考大家。Let's make a new song.让我们一起来创作一首新的歌谣吧。First, let's listen to this boy.Two little bees sitting on my back.One named Tom, one named May.Fly away Tom, fly away May.Come back Tom, come back May.Do you want to have a try?Now, it's your turn.Come back Jack, fly away Jill.Two little black birds sitting on my back.Fly away Tom, one named Jill.今天的课上,我们认识了有关小鸟飞翔的英文单词,还学会了一首歌谣,小朋友们的表现棒棒的!在结束今天的课之前,请小朋友们评价一下自己的表现。Let's turn to page 49.Do you like the class?Can you listen carefully?Can you make a new song?你会创作一首新的歌谣吗?Please color the stars!如果你对英语感兴趣,课后你可以唱一唱这首歌谣。还可以自己在创编一首歌谣,并且跟着伴奏唱一唱哦!You did a very good job today!Thank you for your time!Bye bye!
